news.headline: Tradr ETFs Announces Launch of Triple Threat Series Including Memory ETF Featuring SanDisk
news.summary: Tradr ETFs announced the upcoming launch of a new 'Triple Threat' series of leveraged ETFs, which includes a fund providing 200% daily exposure to a basket of memory stocks, including SanDisk Corporation.

news.headline: SanDisk Chief Accounting Officer Discloses Stock Sale in SEC Filing
news.summary: Michael Pokorny, Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer of SanDisk, sold 26,016 shares of company stock in a transaction reported on November 25, 2026.

news.headline: HSBC Adjusts Price Target on Marvell Technology to $200 From $450
news.summary: HSBC has revised its price target for Marvell Technology, lowering it from $450 to $200.

news.headline: Tradr ETFs Announces Upcoming Launch of Tradr 2X Short MRVL Daily ETF
news.summary: Tradr ETFs has announced plans to launch a new leveraged ETF, the Tradr 2X Short MRVL Daily ETF (Cboe: MRVQ), which is designed to track the daily performance of Marvell Technology, Inc.

news.headline: Oppenheimer and Fubon Adjust Price Targets for Marvell Technology
news.summary: Analysts at Oppenheimer and Fubon have updated their price targets for Marvell Technology, reflecting ongoing market volatility and sector-wide revaluations.
